uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby 4.0 runtime support in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment adds support for the Ruby 4.0 runtime in General Availability; App Engine flexible environment adds support for the Ruby 4.0 runtime in Preview.

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.2+ transport security support in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment supports TLS 1.2 and later with an updated secure cipher suite set.

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.1 and earlier protocol support in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for TLS 1.1 and earlier is deprecated in App Engine flexible environment, with guidance to move to TLS 1.2 and later; deprecated on 2025-03.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby 3.4 runtime support in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment adds General Availability support for the Ruby 3.4 runtime; App Engine flexible environment adds Preview support for the Ruby 3.4 runtime.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby 3.3 runtime support in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment adds General Availability support for the Ruby 3.3 runtime; App Engine flexible environment adds Preview support for the Ruby 3.3 runtime.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Runtime lifecycle-stage filtering in App Engine console
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine page in Google Cloud Console now allows filtering versions by runtime lifecycle stage and shows warning icons for support/deprecation status.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby 3.2 runtime support in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment makes the Ruby 3.2 runtime generally available, requiring an operating system version in app.yaml; App Engine flexible environment adds Preview support for the Ruby 3.2 runtime, with a required operating system version in app.yaml.

uncovered_features.feature_name: SSH access for internal-only flexible environment instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment now supports SSH login to instances that use only internal IP addresses.
keywords: SSH to internal-only App Engine Flex
App Engine Flex internal IP SSH

uncovered_features.feature_name: Internal IP mode for App Engine flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environments now allow setting IP mode to internal for instances.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Disable external ephemeral IP addresses for App Engine Flex
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Flex services can now disable external ephemeral IP addresses.
keywords: App Engine Flex no external ephemeral IP

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-west1, asia-southeast1, and asia-east1 regions; App Engine became available in the europe-central2 region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: External HTTP(S) Load Balancing for App Engine via serverless NEGs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine now supports external HTTP(S) Load Balancing through Serverless Network Endpoint Groups.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine resource labeling for billing and BigQuery export
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine now supports labeling resources and exporting billing data to BigQuery for per-resource billing analysis.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in asia-northeast3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the asia-northeast3 (Seoul) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in us-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the us-west3 (Salt Lake City, Utah) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in asia-northeast2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the asia-northeast2 (Osaka, Japan) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in europe-west6
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the europe-west6 (Zurich, Switzerland) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in asia-east2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the asia-east2 (Hong Kong) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in us-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the us-west2 (Los Angeles) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Debian 8 Jessie deprecation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Google announced migration away from Debian 8 Jessie to Ubuntu 16.04 for App Engine flexible environment applications, with redeploy required by the migration date; deprecated on 2018-05-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine availability in northamerica-northeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine launched in the northamerica-northeast1 (Montreal, Canada) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine deployment IAM role documentation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine updated its access-control documentation to clarify deployment using IAM roles and required permissions.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region availability (asia-south1)
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine added support for the asia-south1 (Mumbai, India) region; App Engine added a deployment region in southamerica-east1 (São Paulo, Brazil).

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment default gzip response compression
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment apps now use gzip compression for all responses by default after redeployment without requiring app.yaml changes.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment per-second instance billing
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Instance billing for App Engine flexible environments was changed to per-second increments with a 1-minute minimum usage threshold.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Legacy App Engine health checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Legacy health checks were scheduled for removal and are no longer available after the deprecation date; deprecated on 2018-09-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine custom domain mapping commands and APIs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Commands and Admin API methods for custom domain mapping, including domain verification and `apps.authorizedDomains.list`, reached general availability.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine managed SSL certificates
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Existing domain mappings and SSL certificates remain functional, and existing setups can be upgraded to managed SSL certificates.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine managed SSL certificates for custom domains
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Managed SSL certificates became available for custom domains, automating certificate provisioning, renewal, and revocation after domain mapping.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment region availability: europe-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment became available in the Europe West 3 (Frankfurt, Germany) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment region availability: australia-southeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment became available in the australia-southeast1 (Sydney, Australia) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Updated health checks for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment added beta updated health checks that can separately verify that an instance is running and ready to serve content.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby default interpreter version update
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The default Ruby interpreter version for App Engine flexible environment was updated to Ruby 2.3.4.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment region availability: europe-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment became available in the Europe West 2 (London) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment region availability: us-east4
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment became available in the us-east4 (North Virginia) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: PHP 7 runtime for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment added support for a PHP 7 runtime and marked it as Beta.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment app.yaml env setting
uncovered_features.feature_summary: New flexible-environment applications were required to use the env configuration in app.yaml instead of vm:true.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ruby runtime default version in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Ruby runtime began defaulting to Ruby 2.3.3, with other versions selectable via a root .ruby-version file.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment selection via env:flex
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The deployment configuration to use the flexible environment was standardized on env:flex instead of vm:true.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Asia-Northeast1 region availability for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment was made available in the asia-northeast1 region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Custom machine types for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Custom machine types became available for App Engine flexible environment instances.

uncovered_features.feature_summary: The jetty9-compat runtime was deprecated; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Modern networking stack with increased throughput
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment introduced a modernized networking stack that improved throughput.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Multi-zonal deployment for App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment added support for multi-zonal deployments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: python-compat runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The python-compat runtime was deprecated; deprecated on 2016-11-15.

uncovered_features.feature_summary: The python27 runtime was deprecated; deprecated on 2016-11-15.
